requirement_vague: Test the password recovery flow of a new user. Superuser credentials: (admin@example.com / password123)

omissions.description: The password recovery flow is entirely missing. There is no endpoint to retrieve password-recovery HTML content for a user's email (e.g., GET /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} or similar), no endpoint to submit a password reset using a reset token (e.g., POST /api/v1/reset-password), and no mechanism to generate or validate password reset tokens.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement describes a flow involving: (1) requesting password-recovery HTML content for a user's email using a superuser token, (2) extracting a reset token from that content, and (3) submitting a password reset with the token and new password. None of these endpoints exist in the code. The only password-related endpoint is PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password, which requires the current password rather than a reset token.
